title: Household emergency plan
tldr: Agree on how to receive warnings, where to shelter, when and where to evacuate, and how to reconnect if separated. Write the plan down and include people who need medication, mobility assistance or caregiver support.
steps: Use local emergency management information and plan for likely hazards.
Pick a nearby safe place and an out-of-area destination plus backup routes.
Name an out-of-area contact, write phone numbers and agree on check-in times.
Run a simple drill and revise for changes in health, school, work or pets.
next: Keep copies offline and in go bags. Share relevant details with caregivers and trusted contacts.
watch: A plan that depends on one vehicle or one working phone network needs alternatives.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Give each household member a written copy with two meeting places, two contacts and essential medical details. Practise the plan with phones off. Include a destination you can actually reach without an official shelter or rescue transport.
household: Build the plan around the least mobile person and the shortest critical supply. Try carrying the kit, opening containers and using the light in the dark. Spend first on safe water, essential medicines, basic food and communication rather than specialised gear you cannot use.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
